end.summary:
Ishita practised visualising square-number sequences with dot pictures.
They identified square-number terms and explained growth by adding a row and column.
They used the corner-dot overlap to explain why one dot must be subtracted.
An initial count of the new dots was corrected through later discussion; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Ishita practised showing how square patterns grow on a geoboard and using the picture to explain the counting rule. They explained that the corner is counted in both the new row and column, so one must be subtracted. An earlier count of the added dots was corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask them to draw two consecutive square numbers and label the new row, new column, and shared corner.
